description_en: Retrieves historical job details of a Data Lake Analytics (DLA) Spark virtual cluster by page
description_zh: 分页提取某个数据湖分析Spark虚拟集群的历史作业详情信息
kebab_example: aliyun openanalytics-open list-spark-job --vc-name MySparkCluster --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --condition jobName=SparkPi createTime=2020-12-28_09:00:00 --api-version 2018-06-19 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSparkJob

parameters.help_en: The name of the virtual cluster that runs Spark jobs
parameters.help_zh: 执行Spark作业的虚拟集群名称
parameters.name: vc_name

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. This parameter is used to traverse all data
parameters.help_zh: 指定需要查询的页码号，用于遍历全部数据，页码的编码从1开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of jobs to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的作业的个数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for retrieving historical job details of the Spark virtual cluster. If you leave this parameter empty, no filter condition is applied
parameters.help_zh: 提取Spark虚拟集群的历史作业详情信息的过滤条件，不填写表示没有过滤条件
parameters.name: condition
